properties.name: Ergenekon — Birth of the Turks
properties.summary: After a devastating defeat, the last surviving Turks fled to the mythical Ergenekon valley, surrounded by impassable mountains. For generations they lived in isolation. When they grew too numerous, a blacksmith melted the iron mountain with a great fire, and a grey wolf (Bozkurt) led them out to conquer the steppe.

properties.name: Book of Dede Korkut
properties.summary: The epic tales of Dede Korkut recount the adventures of Oghuz Turkish heroes. Bamsi Beyrek endures trials to marry his beloved. Kan Turali fights monsters to win a warrior princess. The wise bard Dede Korkut advises and narrates, his songs shaping destiny. Each tale upholds honor, bravery, and loyalty.

properties.name: Tengri and the World Tree
properties.summary: The Turkic cosmos is organized around a great World Tree connecting three realms: the upper sky-realm of Tengri, the middle world of humans, and the lower realm of Erlik. Shamans climb the tree in trance to communicate between worlds. Sixteen-layered heavens and seven-layered underworld contain various spirits.

properties.name: Alp Er Tunga — The Great King
properties.summary: Alp Er Tunga (identified with the Persian Afrasiyab) was a legendary Turkic king who waged wars against Iran. His death was sung in elegies across the Turkic world. Mahmud of Kashgar recorded mourning poems in the Divan. He represented the ideal Turkic ruler — brave, just, and fierce in battle.
